Wired into scripts/automatic-arbitrage-cycle.mjs's operate() execution gate and src/opportunity-feed.mjs's display feed. New file src/core/resourceCostModel.mjs; additive fields on hiveEngineConfirmation.mjs's assessBeedFeeWitness/observeBeedFeeWitness (rcSwapHive overhead, beedFeeMarkSwapHive).

priceResourceCosts now prices exactly Hive RC plus signer plus runner overhead against NET_FLOOR_MARGIN_SWAP_HIVE, performing the RC-capacity-floor and net-floor checks itself instead of delegating them to the removed BEED witness

an unpriced-resource-cost-model cycle result now carries reason, stillUnpriced, and components so a deployed journal can show which resource failed and why; verified the live journal never carried this diagnostic before this change

v.summary: Replaced src/core/resourceCostModel.mjs's Hive-RC-to-SWAP.HIVE pricing (built on a hivepegged conversion the corpus already flags as unverified/nonexistent) with a capacity-only check: refuse rc-capacity-insufficient when a cycle would eat into a declared RC_CYCLE_RESERVE_PERCENT (default 20 percent) reserve of the account's total RC capacity, otherwise price Hive RC at zero and report the witness values in the component. Deleted hiveToSwapHiveUnits, HIVEPEGGED_DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS, HIVEPEGGED_MINIMUM_FEE_HIVE, RC_COST_TOLERANCE_PERCENT, RC_RESERVE_SAFETY_MULTIPLE, and their tests. RESOURCE_COMPONENT_NAMES unchanged (still Hive RC, signer, runner/paymaster). Updated stale BEED-fee comments in scripts/automatic-arbitrage-cycle.mjs and src/opportunity-feed.mjs, and rewrote the README's cost-model description. Also made test/automaticArbitrageCycle.test.mts's cloud-signer test hermetic (it previously called the real default pricer unmocked, which -- once RC pricing legitimately clears the net floor -- reaches the live cold-red-gate signer over real SSH; observed this during the pre-publish test run). resourceCostModel.mjs is not re-exported through src/index.mts or any package.json export/bin surface, so the change is additive/internal-only from the published package's public surface.

Removed the invented BEED balance/bid-book fee check (and the parallel local-side check) from cold-red-gate-arbitrage-broadcast.mjs; the remote signer now re-checks the certified round trip against a fresh marketpools reserve read for slippage, and refuses datum route-stale when the fresh worst-case profit no longer clears the priced signer+runner overhead (wired from resourceCostModel.mjs priceResourceCosts via automatic-arbitrage-cycle.mjs) plus NET_FLOOR_MARGIN_SWAP_HIVE.

v.summary: After the 0.4.3 fix removed the invented BEED balance/bid-book cost-model check from cold-red-gate-arbitrage-broadcast.mjs and replaced it with a fresh marketpools-reserve slippage re-check plus priced signer+runner overhead gate, execution reached further than ever before -- exposing a second, previously-dormant defect: the ACCOUNTS map in cold-red-gate-arbitrage-broadcast.mjs hardcoded each account keyFile as an absolute bare-cedar-fog CHECKOUT path (.../bare-cedar-fog-services-section/data/runtime/config/blockchain/hive/<account>/active.wif), which does not exist on cold-red-gate -- the real keys there live at ~/.config/blockchain/hive/<account>/active.wif. aagaard-michael-capital-circulation.service crashed with ENOENT at the statSync(KEY) guard (before any Waggle broadcast call) on its 2026-09-05T04:35:53Z catch-up run, immediately after both timers were restarted.

Fixes the key-path defect the 0.4.3 fix exposed on cold-red-gate: ACCOUNTS.<account>.keyFile in cold-red-gate-arbitrage-broadcast.mjs hardcoded the bare-cedar-fog checkout path, which does not exist on cold-red-gate. Added AAGAARD_COLD_RED_GATE_KEY_ROOT (default unchanged, exported as DEFAULT_KEY_ROOT), mirroring automatic-arbitrage-cycle.mjs's existing AAGAARD_MACHINES_RECORD_PATH pattern.

Fixes a third defect the 0.4.3/0.4.4 fixes exposed on cold-red-gate: remoteSource() hardcoded an absolute bare-cedar-fog checkout path to dynamically import the Waggle client/keys modules, which do not exist at that path on cold-red-gate (a materialized release tree) -- ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND crashed aagaard-sigmund-capital-circulation.service. Fixed by computing WAGGLE_CLIENT_URL/WAGGLE_KEYS_URL relative to this file's own import.meta.url (the waggle modules ship inside this same package, so this is correct on any host running this exact file, never a second hardcoded path).

Real incident fix: michael561 broadcast a bundled swapTokens+sell custom_json at 05:15:18Z (txid a6308f23ba5026f1e670e61cea257eaf62524322) whose sell leg failed on-chain ("not enough tokens for multiTransaction fee") because Hive-Engine resourcemanager charges a real 0.001 BEED fee for bundling 2+ actions past numberOfFreeTx=1 -- a real fee the earlier BEED-bid-book check was wrongly approximating. Split the round trip into two standalone single-action custom_json legs (swap, then sell), each independently gated by its own fresh route-stale check (pool reserves for the swap; order-book depth for the sell) and, for the sell leg, a re-derived worst-case-profit-vs-overhead gate using the paired leg cost. Kept the legacy 2-action bundle path defensively, now gated by a live resourcemanager.params BEED-floor read (no invented substitute). Every remoteSource refusal now returns {status:"refused",datum,reason} and exits 0 instead of throwing -- a refusal is not a crash. Added a standalone reconciliation-sell target/shape for closing out a residue position with no paired leg. hiveEngineConfirmation.mjs gained assessSwapLegEffect/assessSellLegEffect for per-leg on-chain confirmation. automatic-arbitrage-cycle.mjs orchestrates swap-then-confirm-then-sell-then-confirm for the cold-red-gate lane; the local-keyFile fallback lane is unchanged (still the legacy bundle via hive-broadcast.mjs).
